title: Personalized federal learning method based on self-adaptive local aggregation

pse.problem: Lack of data for specific applications due to privacy concerns and data ownership issues, leading to inefficiencies in training large AI models. Inconsistency among clients' data collection methods results in a global model that fails to adapt to local data and poor generalization.
pse.solution_function: A personalized federated learning method based on adaptive local aggregation aims to learn a model suitable for the local data set for each client by accurately extracting useful information from the global model at low network communication cost, reducing data privacy leakage risk and improving training efficiency.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of multiple clients, a server, and AI models (global and local). The local model is trained on the client's data, while the global model aggregates information from all participating clients after each round of training.
pse.solution_implementation: In each round of training, the server sends the global model to clients. Clients train their local models using their data and send updated local models back to the server. The server performs adaptive local aggregation by identifying important information from the received local models, generating a new global model.
pse.effect: The solution allows for efficient personalized training of AI models while protecting data privacy, reducing network communication costs, minimizing data privacy leakage risks, and improving the quality of the learned local models
